items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Well John played pretty good Tuesday, wasn't he?

ctx.x: See them people used to play the Little E-Fact clarinet. Can't find none there. Some of them used to play C clarinet.
Well John played pretty good Tuesday, wasn't he? Yeah, Tuesday. What the? The merry-go-round had a funeral.
Had a funeral. Oh yeah, the merry-go-round. Yeah, that's an old club too. Yeah, that's an old club. They still got their dance hall up there? I'm telling you some of it?
